summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Companhia Siderúrgica Nacional (CSN), a Brazilian steel company, announcing the filing of its Annual Report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, with the SEC. No special situation event—such as acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or management change—is described. The filing merely notifies shareholders of the availability of the annual report and audited financial statements in hard copy or online. As a standard periodic reporting requirement, this filing does not trigger any special-situations classification.
